base.openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Shop
  version: "1.0"
paths:
  /orders:
    get:
      summary: List orders
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: integer }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ok
    post:
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
      responses:
        "201":
          description: created
  /orders/{id}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/OrderId"
    get:
      responses:
        "200":
          description: ok
        "404":
          description: missing
components:
  parameters:
    OrderId:
      name: id
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
